result.rationale: PurposeEnergy is the manager-level Quinbrook portfolio company and St. Albans Industrial Treatment is a project/SPV beneath it. PurposeEnergy and Vermont sources support the facility identity, permittee, construction and operating chronology. The standalone SAINT record should be retired into PurposeEnergy while retaining project aliases, milestones and direct evidence; no distinct sponsor co-owner or later equity transfer was identified.
